name: Stability Assessment Report
description: This report shows Stability Assessment for patients having drugs

config.sql: SELECT DISTINCT o.person_id FROM obs o INNER JOIN encounter e ON o.encounter_id = e.encounter_id WHERE o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid IN ('e5aaaa9a-2224-42c7-b6d3-efd6a56064da', '162942AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA')) AND o.value_coded IS NOT NULL AND e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid = '8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f') AND e.encounter_datetime >= :startDate AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 AND e.voided = 0

SELECT DISTINCT o.person_id FROM obs o INNER JOIN encounter e ON o.encounter_id = e.encounter_id WHERE o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid IN ('e5aaaa9a-2224-42c7-b6d3-efd6a56064da', '162942AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA')) AND o.value_coded IS NOT NULL AND e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid = '8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f') AND e.encounter_datetime >= :startDate AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 AND e.voided = 0
SELECT DATE(value_datetime) FROM obs WHERE concept_id = 99161 AND person_id = :patientId AND voided = 0 ORDER BY obs_datetime ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT MIN(DATE(o.obs_datetime)) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid IN ('e5aaaa9a-2224-42c7-b6d3-efd6a56064da', '162942AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA')) AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.voided = 0
SELECT DATE(obs_datetime) FROM obs WHERE concept_id = 856 AND person_id = :patientId AND obs_datetime <= :endDate AND voided = 0 ORDER BY obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT cn.name FROM concept_name cn WHERE cn.concept_id = o.value_coded AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND cn.voided = 0) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = 'e5d967a6-1d5f-11e0-b929-000c29ad1d07') AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT value_numeric FROM obs WHERE concept_id = 856 AND person_id = :patientId AND obs_datetime <= :endDate AND voided = 0 ORDER BY obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT cn.name FROM concept_name cn WHERE cn.concept_id = o.value_coded AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND cn.voided = 0) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid IN ('e5aaaa9a-2224-42c7-b6d3-efd6a56064da', '162942AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA')) AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT cn.name FROM concept_name cn WHERE cn.concept_id = o.value_coded AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND cn.voided = 0) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '164960AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA') AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE(o.value_datetime) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '164960AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA') AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(e.encounter_datetime)) >= 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM encounter e WHERE e.patient_id = :patientId AND e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND e.encounter_datetime >= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND e.voided = 0

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(e.encounter_datetime)) >= 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM encounter e WHERE e.patient_id = :patientId AND e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND e.encounter_datetime >= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 2 MONTH) AND e.encounter_datetime < DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND e.voided = 0

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(e.encounter_datetime)) >= 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM encounter e WHERE e.patient_id = :patientId AND e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND e.encounter_datetime >= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 3 MONTH) AND e.encounter_datetime < DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 2 MONTH) AND e.voided = 0

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(e.encounter_datetime)) >= 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM encounter e WHERE e.patient_id = :patientId AND e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND e.encounter_datetime >= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 4 MONTH) AND e.encounter_datetime < DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 3 MONTH) AND e.voided = 0

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(e.encounter_datetime)) >= 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM encounter e WHERE e.patient_id = :patientId AND e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND e.encounter_datetime >= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 5 MONTH) AND e.encounter_datetime < DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 4 MONTH) AND e.voided = 0

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(e.encounter_datetime)) >= 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM encounter e WHERE e.patient_id = :patientId AND e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND e.encounter_datetime >= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) AND e.encounter_datetime < DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 5 MONTH) AND e.voided = 0

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(e.encounter_datetime)) FROM encounter e WHERE e.patient_id = :patientId AND e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND e.encounter_datetime >= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND e.voided = 0) >= 6 THEN 'Stable' ELSE 'Not Stable' END
